name: Aseante Ard
subject: Linear Algebra
review: Decory completely turned things around for me when I was struggling with college Linear Algebra. He has a great way of breaking down tough, confusing math concepts into simple, clear steps. Thanks to his patience and encouraging style, I went from being completely overwhelmed to feeling genuinely confident in my skills.

name: Sade Butt
subject: MBA Economics
review: Decory is so thorough and patient. For an arduous course like MBA Economics, he managed to explain appropriate and practical applications for the formulas to reinforce my understanding. Decory diagnosed my learning style as visual, so he adjusted his teaching style by writing out equations in granular detail. He facilitated a learning space that empowered me to ask questions if ever felt unsure.
